enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Bashing +23%: +23% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Legendary Conditioning +5%: You have a +5% Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit Points.
Shield Spikes: This effect causes this shield to do an extra 7d6 Piercing damage when it is used to shield bash.
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
